links.outcome: Readability of chatbot cancer pain responses against prespecified patient-education grade-level benchmarks
links.effect: Model medians exceeded prespecified grade-level benchmarks and FRES medians were below 80; all six readability indices differed across models, with Gemini descriptively hardest to read.
links.quote: Model medians exceeded the prespecified grade-level benchmarks, and FRES medians were below 80.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates responses from four commercial LLM chatbots to cancer pain queries, measuring readability and information quality benchmarks without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
